name: ship
description: A container ship: a lofted steel hull with a raked, flared bow, a bulb and a transom stern, red antifouling below the waterline, container stacks on hatch covers, an aft accommodation block with a winged bridge, funnel and radar mast, a free-fall lifeboat, a rudder and a five-blade propeller.

params.name: draught
params.description: How deep the hull sits below the waterline.
